messages:
deploy-bot: Release v3.8.1 -> prod attempted but block: env-parity-check failed for ingress annotations (missing x-client-rate header passthrough in prod).

alex: ugh, can you paste the diff?

ops-bot: Detected diff: staging ingress nginx-ingress/default-app -> annotations:
  - nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet: |
      more_set_headers "x-client-rate: $limit";
  + (present in staging)

  prod ingress nginx-ingress/default-app -> annotations:
  - nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet: |
      # no x-client-rate header set
  + (missing in prod)

mira: That header is required by the routing layer to apply per-customer throttles for inference. If prod doesn't pass it through the rate limiter will apply default and we blow the SLA.

sam: Can we patch prod quickly or do we pin the release?

natalie: We should avoid a direct patch during the change window unless it's a config-safe hotpatch. Is this safe to add an annotation and reload?

alex: It looks like a non-breaking annotation injection, but we need rollout notes and QA. Also confirm the nginx version in prod matches staging — different templating could ignore snippet.

mira: nginx versions: staging 1.21.8, prod 1.20.3 — minor behavior diff. ops-bot said config-snippet supported but templating escapes variables differently in 1.20.x.

deploy-bot: Suggested action: HOLD release. Options: 1) pin image tag to v3.8.0 (no ingress change) and continue release window for other services, 2) schedule ingress annotation backfill + canary and promote after verification, 3) emergency inline patch now (ops risk).

sam: I vote for option 1 to avoid surprises. We can ship a separate ingress hotfix once we confirm templating behavior.

mira: agree. I'll open a runbook for the hotfix and write the verification checklist (header present, rate limiter sees header, smoke gen requests pass).

alex: I'll update the release notes and pin the release in the deploy manifest to image:v3.8.0. Add an entry to changelog: "postponed ingress header passthrough fix; release pinned".

natalie: I'll set the change-window follow-up for tomorrow 09:30 PT and assign to infra-oncall for the canary.

ops-bot: Patch suggestion (if we go hotfix later):
```
kubectl -n ingress patch ingress default-app --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/metadata/annotations/nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io~1configuration-snippet","value":"more_set_headers \"x-client-rate: $limit\";"}]'
```
Verify: curl -sI https://app.prod.internal/health | grep -i x-client-rate

deploy-bot: Release v3.8.1 marked: HOLD (reason: ingress annotation parity). Pinned to image:v3.8.0 and scheduled follow-up. :warning:
